sections.title: Overview
body: Unified Project Portfolio
Power BI | Power Apps | Excel | ETL | AWS
A showcase of dashboards, workflow automation, analytics, and data engineering projects.
Portfolio at a glance
This portfolio combines five projects that show end-to-end capability in business reporting, low-code app development, Excel-based analysis, and cloud ETL automation.
Core capabilities demonstrated
Dashboard design and storytelling for business stakeholders.
Low-code process automation with approvals, notifications, and role-based access.
Data preparation and transformation using Power Query and AWS ETL tools.
Operational analytics with KPI tracking, drill-down views, and executive reporting.
1. PMO Enhancements
Ministry of Youth Affairs | Power Platform Solution

This low-code platform replaces spreadsheet tracking and manual follow-ups with a structured project governance workflow. Requests move through staged approvals, approved work becomes trackable projects, and the PMO team can monitor KPIs, milestones, documents, and reporting from one system.
Built with Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint Lists, and Power BI.
Supports Manager -> Chief -> Director approval flow with notifications.
Covers request submission, project creation, milestone updates, documents, and executive reporting.
2. Amazon Dashboard
Power BI retail analytics

An interactive retail dashboard for product and sales analysis. The layout highlights category browsing, product performance, and summary trends so stakeholders can move from overview to detail quickly.
Designed to present sales and product performance in a clean, executive-friendly layout.
Highlights category-level browsing and product-level comparison.
Useful for quick review of trends, stock signals, and product performance.
3. ATM Transactions Analysis Dashboard
Power BI banking operations dashboard

This dashboard summarizes ATM performance through cost analysis, revenue trends, transaction patterns, and regional comparisons. It supports monitoring of operational health and financial performance in a single view.
Shows monthly KPIs, revenue by state, and transaction mix analysis.
Compares financial and non-financial transactions to surface operational behavior.
Provides a detailed drill-down page for granular transaction analysis.
4. Customer Churn ETL Report
AWS Glue | Athena | Airflow | Power BI

This project demonstrates a serverless analytics pipeline. Raw data is stored in S3, cataloged with Glue Crawler, transformed with Glue ETL, queried in Athena, and consumed in Power BI through ODBC. Airflow automates the flow from ingestion to refresh.
Raw, processed, and query-result buckets are organized in S3.
Glue crawler and ETL jobs prepare clean, query-ready data.
Athena and Power BI provide the reporting layer, with Airflow for orchestration.
5. Financial Movie Analysis using Excel
Excel | Power Query | Pivot Tables | Charts
This analysis merges IMDb and TMDb data into a single master dataset, then uses Power Query and Excel visuals to study revenue, budget, ROI, genres, countries, runtime, and rating patterns.
Unified multiple datasets into a single analytical model.
Calculated ROI and explored performance by genre, country, runtime, and release year.
Identified strong budget-revenue relationships and high-ROI cases.
Closing summary

Together, these projects show a practical mix of dashboarding, workflow automation, cloud ETL, and spreadsheet-based analytics. The portfolio is intentionally concise and image-led so it can be used for showcasing, submission, or interviews.

sections.title: Overview
body: Unified Portfolio
Data Analytics | AI | Automation | Computer Vision | ETL | Forecasting
A showcase of selected projects, built for portfolio presentation.
Prepared by ShazilAhmed Shaikh | DEVCORE
Professional Summary

I build practical, end-to-end data and AI solutions that combine clean interfaces, automated pipelines, and decision-support analytics. My work covers dashboards, machine learning prototypes, forecasting notebooks, web automation, and cloud ETL workflows. The common thread across these projects is turning raw data into something usable, visual, and reliable.
Core Strengths
LLMs, RAG, Reinforcement Learning, Vector DB
Python automation, scraping, and computer vision
Dashboard development and data visualization
Machine learning and forecasting workflows
AWS ETL, data integration, and reporting pipelines
Backend integration, APIs, and deployment-ready structure
Selected Projects at a Glance
SI3 Analytics Dashboard
A full-stack analytics platform for tracking LinkedIn growth and email campaign performance in one place.
Key Highlights
Interactive LinkedIn and email analytics views with KPI cards and trend charts.
Excel/CSV upload workflow for analytics ingestion and refresh.
Dockerized deployment structure for repeatable local or production-style runs.
Tech Stack
Next.js, React, TypeScript, Chart.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Multer, Axios, Docker
Work Hour Calculator
A webcam-based computer vision prototype that classifies whether an employee is working or not working and logs time spent in each state.
Key Highlights
Uses MobileNet-SSD for person detection and MediaPipe for landmark extraction.
TensorFlow model predicts working versus not_working from a short frame sequence.
Durations are written to CSV for simple downstream reporting.
Tech Stack
Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, TensorFlow/Keras, CSV logging
Live working-status detection
Berkana AI
An AI-powered financial intelligence platform with chat, memory, market data, sentiment analysis, and forecasting.
Key Highlights
Combines a Flask web app with chat sessions, login, preferences, and history management.
Integrates LLM responses, market/news collection, and vector-style memory search.
Includes forecasting outputs, charts, and a strong focus on confidence and safety controls.
Tech Stack
Flask, PostgreSQL, pgvector-style memory, SpaCy, FinBERT, LLM APIs, XGBoost/LSTM
BiPOP
A translational immunology platform that predicts systemic biological effects and supports reverse design workflows.
Key Highlights
Maps perturbations into organ-level outcomes using scoring, translation, and fit engines.
Includes 3D BidirBody visualization for systemic prediction and interpretation.
Combines Flask APIs, XGBoost models, and cheminformatics checks for a complete workflow.
Tech Stack
Flask, XGBoost, Three.js, RDKit, Pandas, NumPy, Gunicorn
System architecture overview
Customer Churn ETL Dashboard
A cloud ETL and reporting pipeline that prepares churn data for Power BI through AWS services and automation.
Key Highlights
Uses S3, Glue crawlers, Glue jobs, and Athena to transform and query data.
Connects to Power BI through ODBC for a clean reporting layer.
Airflow orchestration supports scheduled and recoverable pipeline execution.
Tech Stack
AWS S3, AWS Glue, Amazon Athena, Power BI, Apache Airflow, Python
Demand Forecasting Notebook
An end-to-end retail forecasting study for Walmart weekly sales, covering analysis, feature engineering, and model comparison.
Key Highlights
Explores seasonality, holidays, store types, and macro variables with clear visual analysis.
Compares XGBoost, SARIMA, LSTM, and Prophet across the same problem.
Shows how classical time-series and ML methods can be evaluated side by side.
Tech Stack
Python, pandas, matplotlib, XGBoost, SARIMA, LSTM, Prophet
Google Maps Business Scraper
A Playwright-based scraping system for extracting business listings, reviews, images, and contact details at scale.
Key Highlights
Includes retry logic, progress tracking, and browser health recovery.
Exports structured CSV files and synchronizes results to Google Drive with rclone.
Designed for multi-city or multi-state scraping with robust recovery support.
Tech Stack
Python, Playwright, pandas, threading, rclone, CSV pipelines
Closing Note

This portfolio brings together projects across analytics, AI, cloud data engineering, forecasting, and automation. Each project was selected to show a different strength: practical problem solving, clean implementation, and the ability to deliver work that is both technical and presentation-ready.
End of portfolio

sections.title: Portfolio Summary
body: The portfolio brings together full-stack and front-end centered projects that show range across service marketplaces, business websites, responsive landing pages, admin systems, and real-time user experiences.
Core strengths
Responsive web design and polished visual presentation
Backend integration for payments, dashboards, workflows, and APIs
CMS and framework-based development for maintainable builds
Conversion-focused layouts for service and business websites
Production-minded delivery with deployment and runtime considerations
Technology profile
Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Tailwind, Bootstrap
Backend: Django, Flask, PHP, Node.js, Firebase
Data and services: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Stripe, Cloudinary, WebSockets, REST APIs

sections.title: 1. SPHERE - Service Marketplace Platform
body: SPHERE is a Django 5 marketplace platform built for service booking, provider operations, payment handling, and live communication between customers and service providers.
What it delivers
Customer booking lifecycle with checkout and status management
Stripe payment flow with payout tracking and reconciliation
Provider product marketplace with cart and inventory handling
Real-time chat and notifications through Channels/WebSockets
Admin workflows for approvals, exports, promotions, and operations
Implementation highlights
Django 5, PostgreSQL, Channels, Daphne, and Stripe integration
Separate app structure for main pages, customers, and providers
WebSocket-based messaging and notification support
Background commands for reminders and data operations
Deployment-ready runtime configuration with ASGI and health checks
Visual snapshot
Portfolio value: SPHERE demonstrates the ability to combine commerce logic, real-time user interaction, and admin-heavy workflows into one cohesive web platform.

sections.title: 2. Pentabytex.com - Digital Agency Website
body: Pentabytex.com is a professional digital agency website focused on AI integration, web development, mobile app development, custom software, digital marketing, and e-commerce services.
What it delivers
Lead-oriented homepage with strong calls to action
Clear service positioning and trust-building content blocks
Team presentation, testimonials, and booking flow
WordPress-based structure for easy content management
Marketing and service messaging aligned with business goals
Implementation highlights
WordPress theme foundation with reusable templates and partials
PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for front-end presentation
Migration-friendly structure for scalable content updates
Conversion-focused layout that supports client acquisition
Suitable for agency branding, service storytelling, and portfolio growth
Portfolio value: Pentabytex.com shows how a business website can be designed to communicate professionalism, services, and credibility while remaining easy to maintain in a CMS environment.
